run_visualize_render_cli: run the visualize_render CLI to batch-render MuJoCo Warp simulation frames and save PNG images
create_render_context_warp: create a MuJoCo Warp render context with configurable resolution, textures, shadows, and segmentation
save_tiled_rendering_grid: save multiple rendered worlds as a tiled grid image for batch visualization
colorize_segmentation_output: colorize integer segmentation IDs into deterministic RGB images for debugging
run_pmap_multi_gpu_rendering: run MuJoCo Warp rendering with jax.pmap across multiple GPUs for parallel batch rendering
